definitions.full: H1535. galgal [ גַּלְגַּל ] noun masculine wheel ( ᵑ7 Biblical Hebrew; Syriac ); — plural suffix גַּלְגִּלּוֺהִ֫י Dan 7:9 of throne-chariot of God.
